d:
Bihar ki lok sanskriti aur aastha ka mahaparv hai chhatha. chhath puja keval ek parv nahin, balki shraddha, vishvas, pavitrata aur prakriti ki upasna ka pratik hai.
Prastut hai "mahilaon ke lie lok aastha", jismen chhath mahaparv ke paranprik lokgiton ke madhyam se chhathi maiya ki mahima, sury upasna aur hamari samriddh lok paranpra ki sundar jhalak dekhne aur sunne ko milegi.
Aaie, chhathi maiya ke bhakti giton ke sath lok aastha aur sanskriti ke is pavan parv ka aanand len.
jay chhathi maiya
